videos.title: Naatak
videos.description: Asha loves someone else and asks her best friend, Sunita, to impersonate her. But when she asks Sunita to marry her fiance, friendship and love collide.

videos.title: Bhediya
videos.description: Bhaskar visits a small town with his cousin for work, but after a wolf attack, his life changes as he gains strange powers and struggles with his new werewolf identity.

videos.title: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
videos.description: Milkha Singh, the Flying Sikh, battles hardships and pain to rise as a world champion, Olympian, and one of India's most legendary and inspiring athletes.

videos.title: Mohra
videos.description: Roma and Jindal free Vishal from jail. Grateful, he joins them, only to realise he's being used as a pawn in a dangerous game of power.

videos.title: Badrinath Ki Dulhaniya
videos.description: Badrinath wants a traditional wife. Vaidehi wants freedom. They must challenge old ways and find their own path. They will redefine what it means to be together.

videos.title: Kambakkht Ishq
videos.description: Simrita, a doctor, operates on Viraj, whom she dislikes. She accidentally leaves her watch inside his and must fix the mistake before her career and life fall apart.

videos.title: Hera Pheri
videos.description: Vijay and Ajay survive by stealing, but their bond is shaken when Vijay learns that Ajay's father might have killed his own father, igniting conflict and testing their loyalty and friendship.

videos.title: Jeene Do: Let Us Live
videos.description: An ambitious cyclist arrives in Mumbai for a championship final, but his world flips when he uncovers his family's painful past, driving him into a dangerous quest for vengeance.

videos.title: Cinebuzz
videos.description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

videos.title: Vardi
videos.description: A fearless police officer takes on a dangerous criminal network, risking his life to uphold justice and protect society from corruption and violence.

videos.title: Dus
videos.description: When terrorist Jamwaal plots destruction in Canada during the Indian Prime Minister's visit, a skilled team of Indian agents is deployed on a dangerous mission to stop his deadly plan.

videos.title: Swades
videos.description: Mohan, an Indian expatriate employed with NASA, travels to his country to track down his beloved nanny, Kaveri. During his stay, he finds himself advocating for reform in a village.

videos.title: Yuva
videos.description: Three Kolkata youths: an idealist leader, a money-minded immigrant aspirant, and a brutal goon become linked after a daylight murder attempt on Hooghly bridge that day.

videos.title: Haseena Maan Jaayegi
videos.description: After a prank angers their father, mischievous brothers Sonu and Monu are sent to Goa for work, where they fall in love and try every trick to win their beloveds' father's approval.

videos.title: Chand Mera Dil - 2026
videos.description: Veera, a carefree man, enters the competitive world of traditional wrestling, where rivalry, romance and determination transform his life.

videos.title: Mahaan
videos.description: A lawyer hides after being falsely accused. His wife gives birth to twins. Years later, fate reunites the family under painful but healing circumstances. Love finds its way back.

videos.title: Cinebuzz
videos.description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

videos.title: Tiger Nageswara Rao
videos.description: In the 1970s, daring thief Tiger Nageswara Rao rises to infamy through audacious heists and ingenious escapes, becoming a legend as he outsmarts the police at every turn.

videos.title: Qila
videos.description: After his brother Jaganath is murdered, Amarnath begins a tense investigation. Shockingly, clues point toward his own sister-in-law and nephew, turning the hunt into a painful battle with suspicion.

videos.title: Deewaar
videos.description: Two Bombay brothers: Vijay the smuggler and Ravi the policeman. Father's disgrace, mother's hardship, and a split path push them toward crime, loyalty, and law.

videos.title: Abhimaan
videos.description: Three brothers separated in childhood are raised in different faiths and eventually reunite as adults, joining forces against criminals while rediscovering their lost family bond.

videos.title: Tevar
videos.description: A kabaddi player tries to safeguard a young woman hounded by a deadly factional leader who wants to marry her against her wish. Eventually, they both fall in love with each other.

videos.title: Albela
videos.description: Tony, a tour guide, falls for his client Sonia and tries to win her heart, but she doesn't feel the same as she is already in love with someone else.

videos.title: Kunwara
videos.description: Raju and Urmila fell in love in New Zealand. Helping a pregnant woman with a troubled past puts Raju's relationship at risk, forcing him to choose between hearts.

videos.title: Aatank
videos.description: A coastal village finds black pearls in the sea, but their greed turns deadly when a fierce man-eating shark rises from the ocean's depths to protect its home.
